{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Rugle''''' was a group of 3 [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were under escort from two [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] when a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ''[[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B Frigate]] [[Dodger (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|Dodger]]''. Despite outnumbering the two Gunboats with multiple fighters. The Gunboats managed to protect the freighters until they reached [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].

The event was then recorded and recreated for the [[Combat chamber]] as a training mission for [[TIE pilot]]s to practice on, one of those was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
